people.name: Kang Chul
people.note: CEO of JN Global and hero of the webtoon W, hunting his family's killer

people.name: O Yeon Ju
people.note: Second-year cardiothoracic surgery resident at Myungse Hospital; the webtoon's author is her father

people.name: O Seong Mu
people.note: Webtoon artist, creator of W; divorced, drinks; the faceless killer wears his face from episode 10

people.name: Park Su Bong
people.note: Seong Mu's studio assistant, draws the backgrounds; the first to believe Yeon-joo

people.name: Park Min Su
people.note: Yeon-joo's professor, nicknamed 'Crazy Dog'; W's most devoted fan, then its loudest anti-fan

people.name: Kim Pung Ho
people.note: Crazy Dog's friend, Yeon-joo's blind date

people.name: Seo Do Yun
people.note: Kang Chul's bodyguard and closest friend; runs his foundation at the end

people.name: Yun Su Hui
people.note: Kang Chul's secretary and childhood friend; the webtoon's intended heroine

people.name: Son Hyeon Seok
people.note: Kang Chul's late father's best friend, 'Ajusshi'; runs his crime show W

people.name: Han Cheol Ho
people.note: Prosecutor turned Assemblyman, presidential hopeful; has hunted Kang Chul for a decade

people.name: Han Sang Hoon / the faceless killer
people.note: The webtoon's villain, drawn without a face or a name until Seong Mu gives him his own; not in MDL's cast, where Kim Eui Sung is listed once as O Seong Mu

people.name: Jun Seok
people.note: Kang Chul's younger brother, murdered in 2006

people.name: Kang Su Yeon
people.note: Kang Chul's younger sister, murdered in 2006

links.label: Kang Chul was the ideal man a teenage Yeon-joo sketched during the 2000 Olympics; her father built W on her stories
links.evidence: He said that Kang Chul was a character you created

links.label: A marriage registered on paper to give her an identity in his world, which they come to mean — the rings go back on in the final episode
links.evidence: the lawyer says he’s in the middle of creating a paper trail to prove that Chul and Yeon-joo had already registered their marriage in the U.S. last year

links.label: She falls in love with him for real; he forgets her when the story is reset, and falls for her a second time
links.evidence: I know it makes no sense. But I’ve fallen in love with you for real.

links.label: With no memory of their first love, Kang Chul falls for Yeon-joo a second time and refuses to become a memory to her again
links.evidence: he has no intention of living that same life all over again, or of becoming nothing but a memory to her

links.label: Pulled into the webtoon, Yeon-joo finds Kang Chul bleeding out on a hotel rooftop and keeps him alive until the ambulance
links.evidence: She grabs a towel and a pair of scissors and runs back up to put pressure on the stab wounds

links.label: She kisses him in a clothing store, hoping a kiss is enough of a cliffhanger to end the episode — and it is
links.evidence: And then she lurches forward and kisses him.

links.label: To prove she is not of his world, he shoots her in the shoulder — the bullet passes through and she does not bleed
links.evidence: He shoots her in the shoulder, and the bullet goes clean through and lands in the mirror behind her

links.label: In the prison visiting booth she tells him his world is inside a manhwa, and he is its hero — and his world freezes
links.evidence: this world is inside a manhwa that she reads

links.label: After he drowns himself, she learns to draw and rescues him out of the river, two months later for her, an instant for him
links.evidence: She shows him the giant red callus on her finger

links.label: Her third "I love you" is the real one, and it sends her home the moment she says it
links.evidence: I’ve fallen in love with you for real

links.label: He asks her to draw everything since the rooftop as a dream, and jumps — waking with no memory of her
links.evidence: Chul looks down at his own hand curiously, having forgotten Yeon-joo entirely

links.label: From her father's tablet she erases his hotel door, the blood, the camera, and draws him the supplies to treat his own wound
links.evidence: we see her at Dad’s desk, frantically doing all the erasing

links.label: On the run, he reads the volume she left behind and learns from a book that he was her husband
links.evidence: he read the manhwa over and over, and now he’s memorized every line

links.label: Shot in his world and brain-dead in hers, she is moved back into the webtoon, where a character can be drawn back to life
links.evidence: Chul says he moved Yeon-joo to the manhwa world because the doctor here said there was no hope.

links.label: Her husband had never said it; on the run in the final episode, he does
links.evidence: You said once that your husband never told you that he loved you… I love you.

links.label: Two years of prison in his world, a week in hers: he is at her bedside when she wakes
links.evidence: there’s Kang Chul, spooning her in the morning as if nothing has happened

links.label: O Seong Mu drew Kang Chul for ten years — and came to fear a creation that rewrote its own story
links.evidence: the father of cardiothoracic surgeon O Yeon Ju, mysteriously goes missing while writing the last chapter of his webtoon 'W'

links.label: Sick of his hero, Seong Mu tries to kill Kang Chul off in the final chapter, by knife, by poison, by truck
links.evidence: he was sick and tired of Kang Chul and wanted to kill him in the manhwa’s final scene

links.label: Kang Chul comes to think of the man who made him as the father of his wife — his family
links.evidence: Not because you’re the god who made me, but because you’re the father of my wife. You’re already my family.

links.label: Pulled into his own webtoon, Seong Mu was the second attacker on the rooftop the night Yeon-joo saved Kang Chul
links.evidence: Kneeling over Chul’s body, Dad had said in a shaky voice, “Let’s end this,” and stabbed him right in the gut

links.label: Told he can never step outside his settings, Kang Chul shoots Seong Mu in his workshop to prove his will is his own
links.evidence: He shoots, and Dad looks down at his bleeding chest in shock.

links.label: A letter on a flash drive: no apology for the shooting, and a plan for Seong Mu to give the killer a face so the story can end
links.short: asked him for a happy ending
links.evidence: Stop running away. Not for me, but for your daughter—you will be able to do it this time.

links.label: Crushed by the killer's memories of shooting his daughter, Seong Mu tries to jump; Kang Chul hauls him back and tells him to save her
links.evidence: He’s halfway over the railing when Chul finds him and yanks him backward.

links.label: Unable to keep the killer out of his own head, Seong Mu begs Kang Chul to bury him in the webtoon before the happy ending
links.short: asked to die in the manhwa
links.evidence: Dad begged him with tears in his eyes for Chul to help him die in the manhwa world before the happy ending.

links.label: With his last strokes, Seong Mu sends the police the proof of Kang Chul's innocence and leaves him a letter
links.evidence: Dad also sends the cops evidence on Ajusshi’s shooting to prove Kang Chul’s innocence

links.label: O Seong Mu is Yeon-joo's father, the famous webtoon artist behind W
links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's father]

links.label: Kil Su Seon is Yeon-joo's mother, who raised her after the divorce
links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's mother]

links.label: Yeon-joo's parents, divorced over his drinking
links.evidence: Yeon-joo's mother and Seong-moo's ex-wife.

links.label: Kil Su Yeong is Yeon-joo's aunt, her mother's sister
links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's aunt]

links.label: She has become the webtoon's heroine — and she is a real person, his daughter — so he ends it
links.short: told her why W must end
links.evidence: You’ve become a main character in the manhwa. You’ve become the heroine.

links.label: With the tablet recovered, Seong Mu draws his dead daughter awake in the webtoon
links.evidence: Su-bong tells her that Dad drew her back to life and is probably on his way to see her

links.label: The killer's memories take him over in the manhwa world, and he attacks his own daughter
links.evidence: Dad is strangling her and ranting like a psycho that he shot her already and doesn’t know why she’s not dead

links.label: He gives the killer's role away to save the hero, and fades from the webtoon in sight of his daughter
links.evidence: He shuts his eyes and accepts his fate, and then he fades away.

links.label: Park Su Bong draws the backgrounds of W in Seong Mu's studio
links.evidence: [Seong Mu's subordinate]

links.label: The first to believe her; her ally in both worlds, and the one who sits with her at the end
links.evidence: He’s so shocked that his legs give out and he falls to the floor

links.label: Su Bong drew Kang Chul's world for three years; when the hero walks into the workshop, he asks for a handshake
links.evidence: Um, Kang hyung… can I shake your hand? I’ve been your fan for a long time.

links.label: Seon Mi is one of Seong Mu's studio assistants
links.evidence: [Seong Mu's subordinate]

links.label: Yun Hui is one of Seong Mu's studio assistants
links.evidence: [Seong Mu's subordinate]

links.label: He remembers her father saying W was built on stories Yeon-joo made up as a girl
links.short: told her she created Kang Chul
links.evidence: Su-bong gets all worked up as he remembers her dad saying that W was based on stories that Yeon-joo had created when she was young

links.label: Assemblyman Han is summoned into the hospital room with the tablet, and Su Bong dives for it
links.evidence: he just dives for the tablet the first chance he gets

links.label: Park Min Su, 'Crazy Dog', is Yeon-joo's supervising professor — and W's most devoted reader
links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's boss]

links.label: Kang Seok Beom is Yeon-joo's fellow resident and close friend at the hospital
links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's co-worker]

links.label: Nurse Jung works alongside Yeon-joo at Myungse Hospital
Her hair was washed, so she is the substitute for his friend's blind date
links.short: set her up on a blind date
links.evidence: so Yeon-joo has to be the substitute

links.label: Kim Pung Ho's blind date with Yeon-joo ends when she is pulled into the river of Kang Chul's world mid-date
links.evidence: Yeon-joo decides that she’s been ignoring her love life too much lately

links.label: Stunned to find her wailing in the emergency room, Crazy Dog turns kind
links.evidence: he tucks his handkerchief into her hand before he goes

links.label: Seo Do Yun is Kang Chul's bodyguard and right-hand man; he is left the foundation at the end
links.evidence: [Kang Cheol's bodyguard]

links.label: Kang Chul sought out the top fighter for lessons, and the two became closest friends
links.evidence: Chul sought out top fighter Do-yoon for martial arts lessons... the boys developed a natural friendship as they trained

links.label: Kang Chul tells the one man he trusts that the corpse in his hideout is his, and to let the world believe it
links.evidence: his head really spins when Chul tells him to come to the hideout, where he’ll find Chul’s dead body

links.label: Kang Chul hands himself to Assemblyman Han to get the tortured Do Yun out
links.evidence: He remains behind, knowing that this is the deal.

links.label: Yun Su Hui has been Kang Chul's secretary for years; she quits, a year before the end
links.evidence: [Kang Cheol's secretary]

links.label: Friends since high school — the webtoon's readers expected them to marry
links.evidence: Kang Cheol's long-time secretary and his friend since they were in high school.

links.label: So Hui has loved Kang Chul since school and never says so; when he marries, she begins to fade
links.evidence: What am I? What was I to you?

links.label: So Hui hands Yeon-joo to the police, sure that Kang Chul cannot go on living with a suspect
links.evidence: So-hee admits to turning her in and says that this was the best she could do in this situation

links.label: For turning Yeon-joo in, he takes away her job and keeps her friendship
links.evidence: That means you don’t have the right to be my assistant.

links.label: A character with no purpose left vanishes; he tells her she is the person closest to him, and she is solid again
links.evidence: You’re important to me. You’re the person closest to me. I need you for the rest of my life.

links.label: Son Hyeon Seok, his late father's best friend, runs Kang Chul's crime show W and is the nearest thing he has to a father
links.evidence: His name is Sohn Hyun-seok, and he’s Chul’s dad’s best friend, who now runs that crime investigation TV show

links.label: A fabricated recording makes Ajusshi suspect, for the first time in ten years, that Kang Chul went home the night his family died
links.evidence: the recording is proof that Chul went home that night that his family died, when he swore that he didn’t

links.label: Prosecutor, then Assemblyman, then presidential candidate: Han Cheol Ho has spent ten years trying to put Kang Chul away for his family's murder
links.evidence: [Prosecutor / Kang Cheol's rival]

links.label: Prosecutor Han asks for the death penalty for the seventeen-year-old gold medallist
links.evidence: Prosecutor Han calls Chul human scum and says it’s his job to keep society clean.

links.label: With the tablet in hand and a hostage tied to a chair, Assemblyman Han beats Kang Chul with a pipe for answers
links.evidence: Assemblyman Han swings at Kang Chul full-force with the pipe over and over and over again

links.label: Assemblyman Han takes Do Yun to bring Kang Chul to him
links.evidence: He yanks the hostage’s head up, and it’s Do-yoon

links.label: Told the story ends only when one of them dies, Assemblyman Han shoots Kang Chul in the chest
links.evidence: Assemblyman Han pulls out a gun and shoots him in the chest

links.label: Kang Chul trades the footage of his own torture for Do Yun, and warns Han never to touch his people again
links.evidence: threatens to turn it over to the police if Assemblyman Han ever attacks one of his people again

links.label: The creator takes his villain with him: Han's own hand raises the gun to his temple
links.evidence: Assemblyman Han’s hand starts to flicker and pull the gun up to his own temple, against his will

links.label: The faceless killer shot Kang Chul's family in 2006 and framed him; Kang Chul has hunted him ever since
links.evidence: The shooter mercilessly guns down Dad, then the little brother, and the little sister

links.label: Given Seong Mu's own face, the killer takes it — and the artist's hands, drawing at the killer's command through the tablet
links.evidence: It’s the same killer who’s been terrorizing Kang Chul, but with Dad’s face

links.label: The killer offers Assemblyman Han the presidency for Kang Chul's head
links.evidence: offers to help make Assemblyman Han the next president

links.label: The hooded figure of the final chapter stabs Kang Chul on the hotel rooftop
links.evidence: shows a hooded figure in black holding a bloody knife in the background as Kang Chul bleeds to death

links.label: The faceless assassin is at Kang Chul's bedroom door with a gun, and vanishes from an elevator
links.evidence: he comes face to face with the black-hooded assassin, raising a gun right in Chul’s face

links.label: From the real world, the killer calls: Kang Chul has a new family now, and it is her turn
links.evidence: I’ll make a bullet hole in her forehead.

links.label: In her own world the bullet is headed for her forehead when she vanishes
links.evidence: The bullet travels in slow-motion, headed straight for Yeon-joo’s forehead.

links.label: Seong Mu lifts his head from the desk and there is nothing there
links.evidence: Su-bong finds Dad slumped over at his desk, and when Dad lifts his head, he has no face.

links.label: A bullet from nowhere, and a drawn gun in Kang Chul's hand: Ajusshi dies and Kang Chul is framed a second time
links.evidence: a bullet comes out of nowhere and shoots Ajusshi right in the heart. He flatlines immediately

links.label: Summoning himself into the manhwa, Kang Chul beats the killer down in his apartment and calls the police
links.evidence: Chul busts through the door with a smirk on his face, and kicks New-Face’s gun away before attacking.

links.label: Wearing her father's face, the killer shoots Yeon-joo as she runs
links.evidence: New-Face whirls around and pulls the trigger… and she goes down, shot in the back.

links.label: A head-on collision and a hail of bullets: the killer dies, and Seong Mu's face comes back
links.evidence: New-Face is no match for Kang Chul’s rage, and the villain goes down, riddled with bullets.
